translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Addaama yeletay hawaappe kaalliide s'aafetteedda. S'oossay asaa med'd'eedda gallassi barena malatisiidde med'd'eedda.
I attuma asaanne mac'c'a asaa ootsi med'd'iide, unttuntta anjjeedda. Unttuntta med'd'iide Asaa
Addaami 130 laytsaa de'iide, barena malatiyaa attuma na'aa yeleedda; Aa «Seeta» giide suntseedda.
Addaami Seeta yeleeddawaappe guyye, 800 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Seeti Heenoosa yeleeddawaappe guyye, 807 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Heenoosi K'aynaana yeleeddawaappe guyye, 815 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
K'aynaani Malaali'eela yeleeddawaappe guyye, 840 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Malaali'eeli Yaareedda yeleeddawaappe guyye, 830 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Yaareed Heenooka yeleeddawaappe guyye, 800 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Maatusaala yeleeddawaappe guyye, Heenooki 300 laytsaa S'oossanna hamettiidde de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
I S'oossanna hamettiidde d'ayeedda; ayaw gooppe, S'oossay Aa afeedda.
Maatusaali Laameeka yeleeddawaappe guyye, 782 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Laameeki 182 laytsaa de'iide, attuma na'aa yeleedda.
«Ha na'ay Med'inaa Goday shek'k'eedda biittaa bollan nuuna nu kushiyaa oosuwaa daaburaappe shemppissana» giide Noha
Laameeki Noha yeleeddawaappe guyye, 595 laytsaa de'eedda; hara attuma naanaanne mac'c'a naanaa yeleedda.
Nohe 500 laytsaa de'iide, Seema, Kaamanne Yaafeeta yeleedda.
